locators.section: 2 Waterways information / 2.1 The river at a glance

locators.title: Foreshore grades from the Gordon River Foreshore survey conducted in 1995

sources.direct_quote: North of Muir Highway the river becomes the Frankland River
own_factual_extraction: The report uses Gordon-Frankland for the combined main channel, distinguishing Gordon upstream from Frankland downstream.
Figure 6.3 names Gordon along the distinctive westward bend; Figure 1.1 gives catchment context.
Nornalup Inlet receives Frankland. Figure 4.1 distinguishes the lower river from the inlet and ocean entrance.
limits: The transition description is regional, not a coordinate or reach-ID boundary.
Figure 1.1 outlines the catchment rather than assigning a name to every stream. Figure 6.3 covers a surveyed section, not all headwaters.
Figure 4.1 is credited to Hodgkin and Clark (1999); it is not counted as a separately acquired independent source.
